plugins.name: bmad-batch-build
plugins.description: BMAD batch build: one bmad-build-auto worker per unit, in parallel worktrees or in turn in one worktree (chosen automatically), then a synthesis agent opens one Azure DevOps PR.

plugins.name: ado-eod-report
plugins.description: End-of-day report from your Azure DevOps board: the day's work items grouped by section, upcoming tasks inferred from them, and blockers, copied as rich text that pastes into Teams with its formatting.
